exposure: Smartphone mobile terminal health assistant app
Smart mobile terminals in out-of-hospital health care management
outcome: Knowledge of health care during pregnancy and perinatal period
cohort: 200 pregnant women who gave birth in a hospital, divided into an observation group using a health assistant app and a control group not participating in app management.
finding: The observation group using the smart mobile health assistant app showed significantly higher knowledge of health care, compliance with prenatal examinations, rate of natural childbirth, and follow-up rates compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The observation group, which utilized the health assistant app, exhibited a significantly higher rate of natural childbirth compared to the control group.
